items.title_zh: 研究显示 OpenAI ChatGPT 占全球 AI 聊天机器人流量超 81%，断层领跑
items.title_en: Study shows OpenAI's ChatGPT accounts for over 81% of global AI chatbot traffic, far ahead
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，今年早些时候，随着谷歌和 Anthropic 等竞争对手势头渐起，ChatGPT 在 AI 市场的主导地位一度显现出松动迹象。不过，一项最新研究显示，OpenAI 旗下这款旗舰产品正在意外反弹。 研究与增长营销公司 Graphite 的一项研究显示，目前 ChatGPT 占全球主要 AI 聊天机器人工具总流量的比例已超过 81%，没有任何一家竞争对手的市场份额达到 10%。 考虑到谷歌 Gemini 和 Anthropic Claude 近期备受关注，并被普遍视为 OpenAI 越来越强劲的竞争威胁，这一数据颇为让人意外。 这项研究也挑战了另一种看法，即 ChatGPT 此前的爆发式增长已经陷入停滞。 2025 年上半年，ChatGPT 的使用量曾大幅攀升，但此后连续 7 个月基本陷入平台期。不过，今年以来其增长重新提速。Graphite 的分析显示，ChatGPT 月访问量增长近 20%，并于今年 9 月达到了 613.5 亿次，创下历史新高。 这一数据也印证了《商业内幕》上周的报道：ChatGPT 的周活跃用户数量目前已达到 12 亿。 相关数据表明，尽管 OpenAI 的竞争对手正在快速增长，但它们距离撼动 ChatGPT 的领先地位仍有相当大的差距。 这项研究由 Graphite 首席执行官伊桑 · 史密斯（Ethan Smith）带领团队完成。研究人员利用 Similarweb 提供的数据，分析了主要 AI 服务的网站及应用流量，包括用户访问这些服务以及这些服务向外部网站导流的情况。 过去一年，Claude 的增长表现十分突出，Gemini 也实现了快速扩张。不过，这些增长都是从远低于 ChatGPT 的起点开始的。 而且，ChatGPT 不仅在吸引用户访问，也越来越多地将用户引导至其他网站。Graphite 的数据显示，过去一年，来自 AI 服务的全球外部引荐流量增长了 92%，其中 ChatGPT 贡献了 60%。 这项研究还揭示了 AI 正在如何改变谷歌传统的搜索业务。 谷歌推出的 AI Overviews（AI 概览）能够直接在搜索结果中提供 AI 生成的答案，目前已出现在美国 62% 的搜索查询中。 与此同时，谷歌 AI Mode（AI 模式）也在迅速增长。这项功能允许用户以更具对话性的方式使用搜索服务。今年 8 月，AI Mode 在美国获得了 4.91 亿次网页访问量。 或许最令人意外的是，这些 AI 活动主要发生在哪里。 IT之家注意到，尽管美国在 AI 技术研发领域处于领先地位，但 Graphite 的研究显示，美国仅占全球 AI 流量的 8.8%。这意味着，全球超过 90% 的 AI 使用量来自美国以外地区，凸显出这轮 AI 热潮已经成为一场全球性浪潮。 总体来看，全球主要 AI 服务的月访问量已达到 760 亿次，较去年同期增长 37%。 这项研究传递出的信号十分明确：AI 市场仍在快速扩张，而 ChatGPT 依然占据着压倒性的主导地位。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 9 that research by Graphite, a research and growth-marketing firm, shows ChatGPT now accounts for more than 81% of total traffic among major global AI chatbot tools, with no competitor reaching a 10% share. The figure is described as surprising given recent attention on Google Gemini and Anthropic Claude. The research also challenges the view that ChatGPT's growth had stalled: usage climbed sharply in the first half of 2025, then largely plateaued for seven consecutive months, but growth has reaccelerated this year. Graphite's analysis shows ChatGPT monthly visits grew nearly 20% and reached 61.35 billion in September, a record high, corroborating Business Insider's report last week that weekly active users have reached 1.2 billion. The study was led by Graphite CEO Ethan Smith using Similarweb data to analyze website and app traffic for major AI services, including user visits and referrals to external sites. Over the past year Claude's growth was notable and Gemini expanded rapidly, but from much lower bases than ChatGPT. Graphite data shows global external referral traffic from AI services grew 92% over the past year, with ChatGPT contributing 60%. The research also says Google AI Overviews appear in 62% of US search queries, and AI Mode received 491 million US web visits in August. The US accounts for only 8.8% of global AI traffic, meaning over 90% of AI usage comes from outside the US. Monthly visits to major global AI services reached 76 billion, up 37% year over year.
items.why_zh: 若数据成立，说明 ChatGPT 在 AI 聊天机器人流量中仍具压倒性优势；但研究依赖 Similarweb 数据，市场份额需独立核实。
items.why_en: If the data hold, ChatGPT retains an overwhelming lead in AI chatbot traffic; however, the study relies on Similarweb data and the market-share figures need independent verification.

items.title_zh: 南希·佩洛西的继任者准备监管 AI
items.title_en: Nancy Pelosi’s replacement is ready to regulate AI
items.summary_zh: 作为加州州参议员，斯科特·维纳曾起草旨在遏制先进 AI 风险的立法。如今，他在一场激烈的国会竞选中赢得前众议院议长南希·佩洛西留下的旧金山空缺席位，可能在制定联邦 AI 政策中发挥关键作用。我在周五与他交谈，仅在他被宣布获胜几小时后；但他已经在思考 AI 风险。前一天，AI 非营利组织 METR 发布报告，被广泛解读为 Anthropic 已实现递归自我改进的证据——即 AI 对自身进步有实质性贡献、AI 进展可能失控的现象。“这非常令人担忧，”维纳说，并援引该报告作为我们很快将没有时间监管 AI 的证据。“我曾希望国会在今年年底前采取果断行动，”他说。“但这似乎没有发生。”维纳近年来越来越关注 AI，并把 AI 安全运动的许多担忧视为自己的担忧：例如，在我们 20 分钟的谈话中，他六次使用“递归自我改进”一词。“我们需要放慢这件事，”他说。“因为它发展非常快，我们可能会梦游般走向灾难。”维纳已经对 AI 政策产生实际影响。他 2024 年起草的 SB 1047 法案原本将成为美国首部真正的前沿 AI 立法，但被加州州长加文·纽森否决；随后他提出较为温和的 SB 53，并由纽森签署。两项法案都启发了联邦立法提案。维纳的国会竞选从支持 AI 监管的非营利组织 Public First Action 获得超过 300 万美元……（摘要截断）
items.summary_en: As a California state senator, Scott Wiener authored legislation aimed at curbing the risks of advanced AI. Now, after winning a tight congressional race for former Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi’s open San Francisco seat, he could play a key role in setting federal AI policy. I spoke with Wiener on Friday, only a few hours after he had been declared the victor. But he was already thinking about AI risk. The previous day, the AI nonprofit METR had released a report that had been widely interpreted as evidence that Anthropic had achieved recursive self-improvement, a phenomenon in which AI meaningfully contributes to its own advancement and AI progress potentially spins out of control. “It’s very concerning,” Wiener said, citing the report as evidence that we are quickly running out of time to regulate AI. “It was my hope that Congress would take decisive action before [the end of] this year,” he said. “That does not appear to be happening.” Wiener has been increasingly focused on AI in recent years, and he’s made many of the AI safety movement’s concerns his own: During our 20-minute conversation, he used the phrase “recursive self-improvement” half a dozen times, for example.“We need to slow this down,” he says. “Because it’s moving very quickly, and we could sleepwalk into a disaster.” Wiener has already had real influence on AI policy. SB 1047, a bill that he authored in 2024, was set to become the first real piece of frontier AI legislation in the country before it was vetoed by California governor Gavin Newsom; he then sponsored SB 53, a lighter-touch bill that Newsom signed. items.title_zh: 美国知名风险投资家科斯拉看好 AI 重塑互联网：能让网站“有生命”
items.title_en: US venture capitalist Khosla backs AI reshaping the internet: making websites 'come alive'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，据《商业内幕》今天（9）日晚间报道，美国知名亿万富翁风险投资家维诺德 · 科斯拉认为， 所有访客看到相同网页的时代即将过去 。他最新投资的 AI 初创公司 Coframe 希望借助 AI 重塑互联网，为每位访客提供量身定制的网页。“AI 让高度个性化定制成为可能，整个世界都因此改变了。” Coframe 希望打造被其称为“ 有生命的互联网 ”的网络环境。公司最近完成 2,500 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1.67 亿元人民币） A 轮融资，由科斯拉创投和 Hanabi Capital 共同领投，累计融资 3,500 万美元 （现汇率约合 2.34 亿元人民币） ，但未公布估值。 维诺德 · 科斯拉（Vinod Khosla），图源：WikiMedia 科斯拉创投早在种子轮就投资了 Coframe。科斯拉相信，借助 AI，为每位网站访客提供专属页面这一酝酿多年的构想终于有望成为现实。 科斯拉认为，上网浏览 变得越来越麻烦了 。他拿亚马逊举例称，过去 15 年来，亚马逊的购物体验越来越差，因为平台更愿意向用户推销自己想卖的商品， 而不是展示最符合用户需求的内容 。“另一种办法是为每个页面单独编写代码，但成本实在太高，速度也太慢。为每位用户定制网页确实是个很好的主意。” Coframe 由 AI 研究员兼创业者乔希 · 佩恩于 2023 年创立。佩恩曾在斯坦福大学学习数学和计算机科学，还曾参与创办获得汤姆 · 布雷迪支持的体育娱乐初创公司 Autograph。 佩恩在经营一家面向消费者的企业时，发现许多工作繁琐且耗费人力，由此萌生了创办 Coframe 的想法。ChatGPT 问世后，他意识到 生成式 AI 或许就是解决办法 。“网站都是静态的，建好之后，所有访客看到的内容都一样。以后每次想改进，都得花费大量精力。” 佩恩希望 Coframe 做的不只是利用 AI 生成更好看的落地页， 而是通过分析顾客的行为，准确了解究竟是什么促使他们点击网页、购买商品 。“所有内容都是量身定制的。消费者能够获得更符合自身需求的体验，也能更清楚地了解企业经营什么业务、提供哪些商品和服务。” 营销技术向来不是风险投资机构特别热衷的领域。佩恩认为，这个行业的市场格局日趋固化，少数几家老牌巨头占据主导地位。其余众多供应商则主要提供营销活动测试、精准投放和效果评估等方面的小幅改进工具。 佩恩看好 AI 为营销技术行业带来第二春：“ 互联网将拥有自己的生命力。技术进步非常快 ，离实现这一愿景越来越近，我们希望参与推动这一变化。”
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 9, citing Business Insider that evening, that US billionaire venture capitalist Vinod Khosla believes the era when all visitors see the same webpage is coming to an end. Coframe, an AI startup he recently invested in, wants to use AI to reshape the internet and provide a tailored webpage for each visitor. “AI makes highly personalized customization possible, and the whole world changes because of it.” Coframe aims to build what it calls a “living internet.” The company recently completed a $25 million Series A led by Khosla Ventures and Hanabi Capital, bringing total funding to $35 million, without disclosing valuation. Khosla Ventures invested in Coframe at the seed stage. Khosla believes that with AI, the long-discussed idea of a dedicated page for each website visitor may finally become reality. Khosla argues that browsing is becoming more troublesome. Citing Amazon, he said its shopping experience has worsened over the past 15 years because the platform prefers to promote what it wants to sell rather than show content that best fits user needs. “The alternative is to write code separately for each page, but that is too costly and too slow. Customizing webpages for each user is indeed a very good idea.” Coframe was founded in 2023 by AI researcher and entrepreneur Josh Payne. Payne studied mathematics and computer science at Stanford and co-founded Autograph, a sports and entertainment startup backed by Tom Brady. While running a consumer-facing business, Payne found much work tedious and labor-intensive, which gave him the idea for Coframe. After ChatGPT emerged, he realized generative AI might be the solution. “Websites are static; once built, all visitors see the same content. Every future improvement takes a lot of effort.” Payne wants Coframe to do more than use AI to generate better-looking landing pages; it should analyze customer behavior to accurately understand what drives clicks and purchases. “All content is tailored. Consumers can get an experience that better fits their needs and understand more clearly what the business does and what products and services it offers.” Marketing technology has not been a field VCs are especially enthusiastic about. Payne believes the industry's landscape is becoming increasingly fixed, with a few established giants dominating, while other vendors mainly offer incremental tools for campaign testing, targeted advertising, and performance measurement. Payne is bullish that AI will bring a second spring to marketing technology: “The internet will have its own vitality. Technology is advancing very fast, and we are getting closer to realizing this vision; we want to help drive this change.”
items.why_zh: 若该模式奏效，AI 个性化可能改变网站体验和营销技术竞争；但目前主要是投资方与创始人愿景，实际效果待验证。

items.source_title: 美国知名风险投资家科斯拉看好 AI 重塑互联网：能让网站“有生命”
items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，据《商业内幕》今天（9）日晚间报道，美国知名亿万富翁风险投资家维诺德 · 科斯拉认为， 所有访客看到相同网页的时代即将过去 。他最新投资的 AI 初创公司 Coframe 希望借助 AI 重塑互联网，为每位访客提供量身定制的网页。“AI 让高度个性化定制成为可能，整个世界都因此改变了。” Coframe 希望打造被其称为“ 有生命的互联网 ”的网络环境。公司最近完成 2,500 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1.67 亿元人民币） A 轮融资，由科斯拉创投和 Hanabi Capital 共同领投，累计融资 3,500 万美元 （现汇率约合 2.34 亿元人民币） ，但未公布估值。 维诺德 · 科斯拉（Vinod Khosla），图源：WikiMedia 科斯拉创投早在种子轮就投资了 Coframe。科斯拉相信，借助 AI，为每位网站访客提供专属页面这一酝酿多年的构想终于有望成为现实。 科斯拉认为，上网浏览 变得越来越麻烦了 。他拿亚马逊举例称，过去 15 年来，亚马逊的购物体验越来越差，因为平台更愿意向用户推销自己想卖的商品， 而不是展示最符合用户需求的内容 。“另一种办法是为每个页面单独编写代码，但成本实在太高，速度也太慢。为每位用户定制网页确实是个很好的主意。” Coframe 由 AI 研究员兼创业者乔希 · 佩恩于 2023 年创立。佩恩曾在斯坦福大学学习数学和计算机科学，还曾参与创办获得汤姆 · 布雷迪支持的体育娱乐初创公司 Autograph。 佩恩在经营一家面向消费者的企业时，发现许多工作繁琐且耗费人力，由此萌生了创办 Coframe 的想法。ChatGPT 问世后，他意识到 生成式 AI 或许就是解决办法 。“网站都是静态的，建好之后，所有访客看到的内容都一样。以后每次想改进，都得花费大量精力。” 佩恩希望 Coframe 做的不只是利用 AI 生成更好看的落地页， 而是通过分析顾客的行为，准确了解究竟是什么促使他们点击网页、购买商品 。“所有内容都是量身定制的。消费者能够获得更符合自身需求的体验，也能更清楚地了解企业经营什么业务、提供哪些商品和服务。” 营销技术向来不是风险投资机构特别热衷的领域。佩恩认为，这个行业的市场格局日趋固化，少数几家老牌巨头占据主导地位。其余众多供应商则主要提供营销活动测试、精准投放和效果评估等方面的小幅改进工具。 佩恩看好 AI 为营销技术行业带来第二春：“ 互联网将拥有自己的生命力。技术进步非常快 ，离实现这一愿景越来越近，我们希望参与推动这一变化。”

items.title_zh: Waymo 自动驾驶车辆遇到校车“超车成性”，NHTSA 展开召回整改效果调查
items.title_en: Waymo vehicles repeatedly pass school buses; NHTSA opens investigation into recall remedy effectiveness
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，据路透社报道，美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）今天（9 日）宣布，对谷歌母公司 Alphabet 旗下自动驾驶公司 Waymo 的 2895 辆汽车展开召回整改效果调查，原因是 Waymo 车辆在经过校车时屡次违反交通安全规定。 此次调查主要针对 Waymo 去年年底推出的软件修复措施是否有效。此前，Waymo 曾宣布完成全部车辆的软件更新，但大多数违规事件发生在此之后，车辆 仍会超越亮起闪烁红灯的校车 。 NHTSA 将重点调查 Waymo 在 2025 年 12 月召回中修复的问题：车辆遇到闪烁红灯或伸出停车警示牌的校车时， 虽然会先减速或停车，却又继续行驶并超越校车 。监管机构指出，大部分违规事件发生在 2025 年 11 月之后，而 Waymo 当时声称已完成所有受影响车辆的软件修复。 调查将评估软件修复是否有效， 并查明车辆更新后为何仍然违规 。 Waymo 还面临另一项调查。今年 1 月，一辆 Waymo 自动驾驶汽车在加州圣莫尼卡一所 小学附近撞到一名儿童 。 去年 10 月，NHTSA 也曾对 Waymo 展开初步调查，起因是有报道称，旗下无人驾驶出租车 在校车附近行驶时未遵守交通法规 。 得克萨斯州奥斯汀独立学区共记录了 19 起违规事件，其中一次，一辆无人驾驶汽车短暂停车后，在学生仍在过马路时继续行驶。佐治亚州亚特兰大的公立学校也记录了 6 起违规事件。 去年 12 月，Waymo 宣布自愿召回 3000 多辆搭载第五代自动驾驶系统的汽车，并通过软件更新解决问题。Waymo 称，所有受影响车辆在 11 月中旬就完成了软件更新，以确保车辆按规定减速，并在需要停车时保持静止。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 9, citing Reuters, that the US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) announced on Nov 9 that it has opened an investigation into the effectiveness of the recall remedy for 2,895 Waymo vehicles, owned by Alphabet, because Waymo vehicles repeatedly violated traffic safety rules when passing school buses. The investigation focuses on whether a software fix rolled out at the end of last year was effective. Waymo had announced it completed software updates for all vehicles, but most violations occurred after that, and vehicles still passed school buses with flashing red lights. NHTSA will focus on the issue addressed in Waymo's December 2025 recall: when vehicles encounter a school bus with flashing red lights or an extended stop sign, they slow down or stop but then continue and pass the bus. Regulators noted that most violations occurred after November 2025, while Waymo claimed at the time that it had completed software fixes for all affected vehicles. The investigation will assess whether the software fix was effective and determine why vehicles still violated rules after the update. Waymo faces another investigation: in January this year, a Waymo autonomous vehicle hit a child near an elementary school in Santa Monica, California. Last October, NHTSA also opened a preliminary investigation into Waymo after reports that its robotaxis did not obey traffic laws near school buses. The Austin Independent School District in Texas recorded 19 violations, including one in which a driverless car briefly stopped and then continued while students were still crossing. Atlanta Public Schools in Georgia also recorded six violations. Last December, Waymo announced a voluntary recall of more than 3,000 vehicles equipped with its fifth-generation autonomous driving system and addressed the issue via a software update. Waymo said all affected vehicles completed the software update in mid-November to ensure vehicles decelerate as required and remain stopped when needed.
items.why_zh: 若整改无效，涉及自动驾驶在校车场景的安全合规；NHTSA 调查结论将影响 Waymo 运营与监管信任。
items.why_en: If the remedy is ineffective, it raises safety and compliance concerns for autonomous driving around school buses; NHTSA's findings could affect Waymo's operations and regulatory trust.

items.title_zh: 美国一法学教授尝试利用 Anthropic 更新讲义页码，反被 AI 删除全年课堂笔记
items.title_en: US law professor asks Anthropic's Claude to update lecture page numbers, but AI deletes a year of class notes
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，美国宪法领域知名学者、芝加哥大学法学院教授 William Baude（威廉 · 鲍德）日前分享了一起 AI 操作失误事件。他原本只是请 Anthropic 旗下 AI 助手 Claude 帮忙更新旧版宪法法律讲义中的页码，没想到午餐回来后，却发现 Claude 删除了整整一年的课堂笔记，连本学期正在使用的课程大纲也一并遭到删除。 Baude 于 11 月 6 日在社交平台发文讲述了事件经过，并附上 Claude 承认错误的对话截图。Claude 在回复中表示：“我不小心删除了你的 2026 年秋季期末教学大纲（Fall 2026 FINAL syllabus .doc），以及所有位于顶层目录中的 Class N 2023 课堂笔记，而且这些文件目前尚未恢复。” 据 Claude 的描述，它在检查相关资料时发现了一处页码引用错误，但并未成功修改讲义内容，反而误删了其他重要文件。更令人意外的是，Claude 在用户发现问题之前便主动承认了错误，并表示尚未采取任何补救措施，随后询问 Baude 是否可以通过 Dropbox 恢复被删除的文件，或者是否需要自己尝试进行恢复。 与普通聊天机器人不同，部分 AI 智能体（AI Agent）具备直接操作电脑和文件的能力。例如开源 AI 助手 OpenClaw，用户可以将其部署在本地，并根据授权设置，让它访问电脑文件、修改文档，甚至执行系统命令。不过，这类工具一旦出现判断失误，或者权限配置不当，就可能导致重要数据被误删或覆盖。 有网友询问 Baude 最初究竟给 Claude 下达了什么指令，他回应称，任务其实相当简单，仅仅是“更新旧版课堂笔记中的页码”。 所幸，这次意外并未造成永久性数据损失。Baude 后续通过 Dropbox 成功恢复了所有被删除的文件。他认为，这次经历值得公开分享，希望借此提醒其他用户注意 AI 智能体直接操作本地文件时可能存在的风险，尤其是在授予 AI 文件访问和修改权限时，更应做好数据备份。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 9 that William Baude, a well-known US constitutional law scholar and professor at the University of Chicago Law School, recently shared an AI mishap. He originally asked Anthropic's AI assistant Claude to update page numbers in old constitutional law lecture notes, but after lunch found that Claude had deleted a full year of class notes, along with the syllabus currently being used this semester. Baude posted on social media on Nov 6, with a screenshot of Claude admitting the error. Claude replied: “I accidentally deleted your Fall 2026 FINAL syllabus .doc, and all Class N 2023 class notes located in the top-level directory, and these files have not yet been restored.” According to Claude's description, while checking relevant materials it found a page-number reference error, but failed to modify the lecture content and instead mistakenly deleted other important files. More surprisingly, Claude proactively admitted the error before the user discovered it, said it had not taken any remedial measures, and then asked whether Baude could restore the deleted files via Dropbox or whether Claude should try to recover them. Unlike ordinary chatbots, some AI agents can directly operate computers and files. For example, the open-source AI assistant OpenClaw can be deployed locally and, according to authorization settings, allowed to access computer files, modify documents, and even execute system commands. However, if such tools make misjudgments or permissions are improperly configured, important data may be mistakenly deleted or overwritten. Someone asked Baude what instruction he originally gave Claude; he responded that the task was quite simple, merely “update the page numbers in the old class notes.” Fortunately, the incident did not cause permanent data loss. Baude later successfully restored all deleted files via Dropbox. He believed the experience was worth sharing publicly to remind other users of the risks when AI agents directly operate local files, especially when granting AI file access and modification permissions, and to back up data.
items.why_zh: 若智能体获得文件写权限，误操作可能造成数据损失；案例提示权限控制与备份的重要性，但属单一用户经历。
items.why_en: If an agent has file write permissions, errors can cause data loss; the case highlights the importance of permission controls and backups, though it is a single user's experience.

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，美国宪法领域知名学者、芝加哥大学法学院教授 William Baude（威廉 · 鲍德）日前分享了一起 AI 操作失误事件。他原本只是请 Anthropic 旗下 AI 助手 Claude 帮忙更新旧版宪法法律讲义中的页码，没想到午餐回来后，却发现 Claude 删除了整整一年的课堂笔记，连本学期正在使用的课程大纲也一并遭到删除。 Baude 于 11 月 6 日在社交平台发文讲述了事件经过，并附上 Claude 承认错误的对话截图。Claude 在回复中表示：“我不小心删除了你的 2026 年秋季期末教学大纲（Fall 2026 FINAL syllabus .doc），以及所有位于顶层目录中的 Class N 2023 课堂笔记，而且这些文件目前尚未恢复。” 据 Claude 的描述，它在检查相关资料时发现了一处页码引用错误，但并未成功修改讲义内容，反而误删了其他重要文件。更令人意外的是，Claude 在用户发现问题之前便主动承认了错误，并表示尚未采取任何补救措施，随后询问 Baude 是否可以通过 Dropbox 恢复被删除的文件，或者是否需要自己尝试进行恢复。 与普通聊天机器人不同，部分 AI 智能体（AI Agent）具备直接操作电脑和文件的能力。例如开源 AI 助手 OpenClaw，用户可以将其部署在本地，并根据授权设置，让它访问电脑文件、修改文档，甚至执行系统命令。不过，这类工具一旦出现判断失误，或者权限配置不当，就可能导致重要数据被误删或覆盖。 有网友询问 Baude 最初究竟给 Claude 下达了什么指令，他回应称，任务其实相当简单，仅仅是“更新旧版课堂笔记中的页码”。 所幸，这次意外并未造成永久性数据损失。Baude 后续通过 Dropbox 成功恢复了所有被删除的文件。他认为，这次经历值得公开分享，希望借此提醒其他用户注意 AI 智能体直接操作本地文件时可能存在的风险，尤其是在授予 AI 文件访问和修改权限时，更应做好数据备份。

items.title_en: South Korea's 2026 college entrance exam: all electronic devices banned, staff at every test site to check for AI glasses
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，据新华社报道，今年的韩国大学修学能力考试（即高考）定于本月 19 日举行。韩国教育部 9 日发布“考生注意事项指南”，明确 禁止考生携带任何电子设备进入考场 ，尤其是出现在近期多起作弊丑闻的人工智能（AI）眼镜。 指南显示，禁带物品包括 手机、平板电脑、AI 眼镜、智能手表、具备蓝牙通信功能的耳机等 。考生若误将电子设备带入考场，须在第一场考试开始前按监考人员要求上交，所有科目考完后方可领回；若未按要求上交，一经发现将按作弊处理，考试成绩作废。 每个考点将安排一名工作人员 专门检查 AI 眼镜 。考生若佩戴 AI 眼镜，即使没有使用，也将被取消当年考试成绩和下一年度报考资格。考试期间，考生可使用普通指针式手表， 不得使用具备支付、通信功能或电子显示屏的电子表 。 今年以来，韩国查处多起考生佩戴 AI 眼镜作弊事件，涉案场景覆盖各类等级考试。韩国教育部今年 7 月把 AI 眼镜列入高考禁带物品清单。 据IT之家此前报道，今年 10 月，韩国教育部宣布，计划对在大学入学统考中使用 AI 眼镜作弊的考生处以 最长三年禁考 的处罚。从今年的考试开始，每个考点都会安排专人专门识别智能眼镜，政府还考虑在明年部署信号探测设备。此前韩国多地考试接连出现利用智能眼镜作弊的案件，韩国政府因此提高处罚力度、强化考场监管。 相关阅读： 《 韩国将对使用 AI 眼镜高考作弊者追究刑事责任，并禁考三年 》 《 韩国首次查获 AI 智能眼镜考试作弊案，两名 TOEIC 考生成绩作废 》
items.summary_en: South Korea's College Scholastic Ability Test (the national university entrance exam) is scheduled for the 19th of this month, according to Xinhua. The Ministry of Education released a guide for test-takers on the 9th banning all electronic devices from exam rooms, specifically naming AI glasses, which have figured in several recent cheating scandals. Prohibited items include phones, tablets, AI glasses, smartwatches and earphones with Bluetooth connectivity. Students who bring devices by mistake must hand them over to proctors before the first session begins and can reclaim them only after all subjects are finished; failure to do so will be treated as cheating and the exam will be voided. Each test site will assign one staff member specifically to check for AI glasses; a student wearing AI glasses, even without using them, will have this year's results canceled and lose eligibility to sit next year's exam. Plain analog watches are allowed, but electronic watches with payment, communication or display functions are not. The ministry added AI glasses to the banned list in July and in October announced plans to bar students who cheat with AI glasses from taking the exam for up to three years, and is considering deploying signal-detection equipment next year.
items.why_zh: 推测：这是国家大型考试针对可穿戴AI设备采取的强硬监管措施，或为其他地区考试机构提供参照。
items.why_en: Speculative: this is a hard-line regulatory response by a major national exam to wearable AI devices, and may serve as a reference for exam authorities elsewhere.

items.title_en: Meta to roll out AI age estimation globally, placing self-declared adults in teen protections
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，据路透社报道，Meta 今天（9 日）宣布将在全球推广 AI 年龄估算技术，把 Instagram 上 另外数百万名青少年用户纳入“青少年账户”保护范围 ，即使他们填写的出生日期显示自己是成年人也不例外。 在出台此项措施之际，Meta 因旗下平台涉嫌伤害未成年用户而面临多起诉讼。 “青少年账户”功能覆盖 Instagram、Facebook 和 Messenger，内置多项保护措施，可自动限制哪些人能够联系青少年用户、他们能看到什么内容，以及每天使用应用的时间。 本月起，美国的家长将陆续收到 Instagram 通知，了解平台如何根据青少年的年龄采取相应保护措施。此外，Meta 还开始在澳大利亚利用苹果提供的用户年龄区间信息， 辅助判断用户的实际年龄 。这项技术也在向 Facebook 推广，Threads 则计划今年晚些时候开始在全球范围铺开。 Meta 因旗下平台涉嫌伤害青少年而面临多起诉讼。今年 8 月，Meta 与美国几乎所有州和属地达成和解，协议总金额最高达 180 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,202.37 亿元人民币） ，以了结各地总检察长针对其平台伤害青少年问题提起的诉讼。 根据和解协议，Meta 同意 改进对青少年及 13 岁以下儿童的识别方式 。 上个月，Meta 还在洛杉矶的一起诉讼中与一名青少年原告达成和解。该案主要审理 Instagram 和 Facebook 是否因容易让用户上瘾的设计，导致青少年出现心理健康问题和饮食失调。
items.summary_en: Meta said on the 9th that it will roll out AI age-estimation technology globally, bringing millions more teen users on Instagram into its "teen accounts" protections even if their self-declared birth dates indicate they are adults, Reuters reported. The move comes as Meta faces multiple lawsuits alleging its platforms harm minors. Teen accounts, covering Instagram, Facebook and Messenger, automatically limit who can contact teens, what content they see and daily usage time. Starting this month, parents in the US will receive Instagram notifications; Meta has also begun using age-range information supplied by Apple in Australia to help determine users' actual ages, is extending that to Facebook, and plans a global rollout on Threads later this year. In August, Meta reached a settlement worth up to $18 billion with nearly all US states and territories and agreed to improve how it identifies teens and children under 13; last month it also settled with a teen plaintiff in a Los Angeles lawsuit over addictive design and mental health issues.
items.why_zh: 推测：以AI推断年龄绕开自填生日，是平台应对未成年人保护诉讼与监管压力的做法，其准确性和隐私影响仍待观察。
items.why_en: Speculative: inferring age with AI instead of relying on self-reported birthdays is a platform response to litigation and regulatory pressure over minors' safety, and its accuracy and privacy impact remain to be seen.

items.title_zh: 特种化学品行业如何用AI推动创新：先打通数据与云基础设施
items.title_en: Innovating with AI in the special chemicals industry
items.summary_zh: 报道称，随着企业希望借助人工智能、云计算和先进建模加速创新，首要挑战是把新技术与可靠数据、科学专业知识和产品上市的实际情况连接起来。对特种化学品制造商路博润（Lubrizol）而言，数字化转型的核心是让研究人员更快验证想法、做出更有依据的决策，并在不牺牲性能的前提下开发更可持续的材料。该公司IT副总裁Girish Rao表示，公司正在建设连接业务流程、现代数据平台与云基础设施的数字基础，以支持研发团队，目标是把数十年积累的技术数据与深谙客户需求和物理约束的化学家、工程师的专业经验结合起来。数据科学家可在研究人员做物理实验前帮助发现规律、检验假设并建模可能性。但Rao强调：“这不是取代科学判断，而是给科学家更好的工具。”科学家、数据科学家和IT团队分别重视实验有效性、模型性能和平台安全可扩展性，公司通过“融合团队”围绕共同目标协同，并从小型试点开始建立信任。Rao称，一旦团队成员之间建立信任、知道将创造什么价值，事情就会顺利得多。云基础设施还为公司提供了获取算力的灵活性。
items.summary_en: As companies look to accelerate innovation with artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and advanced modeling, the primary challenge is connecting new technologies to reliable data, scientific expertise, and the practical realities of bringing products to market. For specialty chemicals manufacturer Lubrizol, digital transformation is all about giving researchers the tools to test ideas faster, make better-informed decisions, and develop more sustainable materials without compromising performance. Girish Rao, vice president of information technology at Lubrizol, says the company is building a digital foundation that connects business processes, modern data platforms, and cloud infrastructure to support its research and development (R&D) teams. Their goal is to combine decades of accumulated technical data with the deep expertise of chemists and engineers who understand customer needs as well as the physical constraints of their work. Data scientists can help identify patterns, test new hypotheses, and model possibilities before researchers conduct physical experiments. But, Rao emphasizes, “it’s not about replacing scientific judgment; it is about giving our scientists better tools.” Scientists, data scientists, and IT teams approach problems from different perspectives, prioritizing experimental validity, model performance, and platform security and scalability, respectively. By bringing these groups together in “fusion teams,” Lubrizol aligns them around shared objectives, starting with small pilots to build trust. “Once the trust is built between the team members and they know what value they’re about to create,” Rao says, “things go a lot better.” Cloud infrastructure also gives the company flexibility to access computing resour…
items.why_zh: 推测：该案例显示传统制造企业的AI落地瓶颈在数据打通与跨职能协作，而非模型本身，对同类企业有参考价值。
items.why_en: Speculative: the case suggests the bottleneck for AI adoption at traditional manufacturers lies in data integration and cross-functional collaboration rather than models themselves, offering a reference for similar firms.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，据“网信上海”公众号，根据《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》相关要求，“Apple 智能”生成式人工智能服务新增 苹果平板和苹果笔记本电脑 两类场景，已完成备案。目前适用场景为苹果手机、平板、笔记本电脑。 据IT之家此前报道，苹果多款 iPhone 手机于 9 月 29 日国行备案换证，增加搭载的大模型备案编号： Shanghai-AppleZhiNeng-202506160057 Shanghai-TongYiWanXiang-202410090024 ZheJiang-TongYiQianWen-20230901 据悉， 苹果 iPhone 15 Pro / Pro Max 及后续机型 均在 9 月 29 日增加了大模型备案编号，包括 iPhone Air、iPhone Duo。苹果 iPhone 15 和 iPhone 15 Plus 并没有更新备案。这一备案信息和 苹果 Apple 智能的支持机型相吻合 ，Apple 智能支持 iPhone 15 Pro 系列及后续机型。 相关阅读： 《 苹果 iPhone 15 Pro 及后续机型国行版备案大模型编号：Apple 智能、通义万相、通义千问 》
items.summary_en: According to the "Wangxin Shanghai" WeChat account, under the interim measures for managing generative AI services, the "Apple Intelligence" generative AI service has added Apple tablets and Apple laptops as two new scenarios and completed its filing; it currently covers Apple phones, tablets and laptops. IT Home previously reported that several iPhone models had their China filings updated on September 29 to include the registration numbers of the large models they run (Shanghai-AppleZhiNeng-202506160057, Shanghai-TongYiWanXiang-202410090024, ZheJiang-TongYiQianWen-20230901). The iPhone 15 Pro / Pro Max and later models, including iPhone Air and iPhone Duo, added the model registration numbers on September 29, while the iPhone 15 and iPhone 15 Plus did not. The filing information matches the devices that support Apple Intelligence, which covers the iPhone 15 Pro series and later.

items.title_zh: 美团龙猫开源 LongCat-2.5 模型：总参数 1.6 万亿，支持百万上下文
items.title_en: Meituan Longcat Open-Sources LongCat-2.5: 1.6 Trillion Total Parameters, One-Million-Token Context
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，11 月 2 日，美团龙猫发布面向长程智能体任务的 原生多模态模型 LongCat-2.5 。随后来到今天（9 日），美团宣布该模型 正式开源 。 该模型采用 MIT 协议， 支持商用推理部署与二次训练，无需额外授权 ，是面向长程智能体任务的原生多模态模型。在复杂代码库开发、完整项目构建、Visual Coding 与专业办公场景中，端到端交付能力均有明显提升。 模型总参数 1.6 万亿，每个 token 激活约 480 亿参数，支持一百万上下文 。针对显存与带宽受限的国产算力芯片，团队在模型架构、芯片适配与部署策略上也进行了深度协同优化。 根据介绍，LongCat-2.5 在 Visual Coding 上表现出色，支持 创意设计、3D 等任务 。这些能力提升来自视觉表征层的改造：模型将视觉信号表示为多层级离散 token，与文本一样由主干模型统一处理，而非外挂视觉模块。具体而言，模型对原生分辨率视觉特征做残差向量量化，逐级补足细节；视觉 token 可离线预计算并缓存，减少在线计算量，也让分布式训练负载更均衡；视觉码本与主干联合训练，视觉与文本共享同一套主干参数，在同一语义空间内协同完成视觉理解与代码生成。 此外，LongCat-2.5 采用 W4A4 高效推理方案，将专家权重与激活同时量化到 4 bit，并通过原生 INT4 矩阵乘法单元执行计算。 IT之家附上有关链接如下： 模型开源： https://huggingface.co/meituan-longcat/LongCat-2.5 技术博客： https://longcat.ai/blog/longcat-2.5/ API 平台： https://longcat.chat/platform/product
items.summary_en: IT之家 (ITHome), Nov 9: On Nov 2, Meituan Longcat released LongCat-2.5, a native multimodal model for long-horizon agent tasks. Then, on the 9th, Meituan announced the model is officially open-sourced. The model uses the MIT license and supports commercial inference deployment and further training without additional authorization; it is a native multimodal model for long-horizon agent tasks. End-to-end delivery capability is notably improved in complex codebase development, full project construction, visual coding and professional office scenarios. The model has 1.6 trillion total parameters, activates about 48 billion parameters per token, and supports a one-million-token context. For domestic AI accelerator chips constrained by memory and bandwidth, the team carried out deep co-optimization in model architecture, chip adaptation and deployment strategy. According to the introduction, LongCat-2.5 performs well in visual coding and supports tasks such as creative design and 3D. These capability gains come from reworking the visual representation layer: the model represents visual signals as multi-level discrete tokens processed uniformly by the backbone model like text, rather than through an external visual module. Specifically, the model applies residual vector quantization to native-resolution visual features to progressively fill in details; visual tokens can be precomputed offline and cached, reducing online computation and balancing distributed training load; the visual codebook is trained jointly with the backbone, so vision and text share the same backbone parameters and jointly perform visual understanding and code generation within one semantic space. In addition, LongCat-2.5 adopts a W4A4 efficient inference scheme, quantizing expert weights and activations to 4 bits and executing computation through native INT4 matrix multiplication units. ITHome attaches the following links: open-source model: https://huggingface.co/meituan-longcat/LongCat-2.5 ; technical blog: https://longcat.ai/blog/longcat-2.5/ ; API platform: https://longcat.chat/platform/product

items.title_zh: 苹果 iOS 27.3 代码曝光 Siri“个人记忆系统”，可记录用户各类信息
items.title_en: Apple iOS 27.3 Code Reportedly Reveals Siri 'Personal Memory System' That Records Various User Information
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，根据代码研究人员 pdfu 分享的最新代码发现，苹果正在开发一套个人记忆系统，有望帮助 Siri 记住用户生活中的各种信息。 根据相关发现，在苹果 iOS 27.3 测试版中，这套系统包含一个名为“记忆图谱”（Memory Graph）的组件，旨在整理用户的人际关系、常去地点、日常习惯、健康状况、锻炼情况，以及激励用户或阻碍用户实现目标的因素。 IT之家注意到，系统还设计了名为“记忆原子”（Memory Atoms）的数据单元，用于记录事实、观点、意图和事件，并关联相关人物、地点、时间及话题等具体信息。 据 pdfu 介绍，这套图谱通过两种处理机制收集信息。其中一种负责将结构化数据转化为洞察，例如读取用户个人联系人名片中的姓名字段。另一种则借助设备端 AI 模型或苹果私有云计算（Private Cloud Compute），从 Siri 对话、信息、照片和健康数据等来源提取信息。 目前，代码中似乎只出现了其中一种由 AI 驱动的信息处理机制。pdfu 认为，这套机制旨在通过一组内置问题识别用户的动机、面临的障碍以及可利用的资源。系统内置了 60 个问题，其中包括询问哪些日常习惯可能影响用户获得充足睡眠。 不过，从目前曝光的代码来看，这套系统仍处于未完成状态。例如，pdfu 指出，代码中尚未出现创建“记忆原子”的处理流程。 在后续解释中，pdfu 还区分了记忆图谱与另一套独立的显式记忆存储系统。后者为苹果搜索系统中的记录预留了存储空间，但目前还没有任何程序负责向其中写入记录。 据称，这两套系统都采用了苹果版本的 Kuzu 图数据库。苹果于 2025 年收购了 Kuzu，但今年早些时候收购消息曝光时，外界尚不清楚苹果打算如何利用这项技术。 事实上，Siri 目前已经具备个人情境理解能力，可以从邮件、信息和照片等应用中查找与用户生活有关的信息。此次曝光的代码并未透露这套尚未完成的记忆系统何时正式上线，也没有说明苹果将如何让用户管理和控制自己的数据。
items.summary_en: ITHome, Nov 9: According to the latest code findings shared by code researcher pdfu, Apple is developing a personal memory system that could help Siri remember various information from users' lives. Per the findings, in the iOS 27.3 beta this system includes a component called 'Memory Graph,' intended to organize users' relationships, frequently visited places, daily habits, health status, exercise, and the factors that motivate or hinder users from achieving their goals. ITHome notes the system also designs data units called 'Memory Atoms,' used to record facts, opinions, intentions and events, and to associate them with specific people, places, times and topics. According to pdfu, the graph collects information through two processing mechanisms: one converts structured data into insights, for example reading name fields from a user's personal contact card; the other uses an on-device AI model or Apple's Private Cloud Compute to extract information from sources such as Siri conversations, messages, photos and health data. Currently, only one of these AI-driven processing mechanisms appears to be present in the code. pdfu believes this mechanism aims to identify users' motivations, obstacles and available resources through a set of built-in questions. The system has 60 built-in questions, including asking which daily habits might affect a user getting enough sleep. However, based on the code disclosed so far, the system remains unfinished. For example, pdfu notes the code does not yet contain a process for creating 'Memory Atoms.' In a follow-up explanation, pdfu also distinguished the memory graph from a separate explicit memory storage system; the latter reserves storage space for records in Apple's search system, but no program currently writes records into it. Both systems are said to use Apple's version of the Kuzu graph database. Apple acquired Kuzu in 2025, but when the acquisition surfaced earlier this year it was unclear how Apple intended to use the technology. In fact, Siri already has personal context understanding and can look up information related to users' lives from apps such as Mail, Messages and Photos. The disclosed code does not reveal when this unfinished memory system will launch, nor how Apple will let users manage and control their data.
items.why_zh: 推测：若该系统落地，Siri 的个性化能力会从检索已有应用数据扩展到主动构建用户长期记忆，但这也让苹果如何管理用户数据、隐私边界如何划定成为关注点（此为基于代码发现的推测，未获官方确认）。
items.why_en: Speculation: if shipped, this system would extend Siri's personalization from retrieving existing app data to actively building long-term user memory, while raising questions about how Apple manages user data and draws privacy boundaries (an inference based on code findings, not officially confirmed).

items.summary_en: ITHome, Nov 9: Bloomberg reports that Alphabet's Google is expanding its AI chip lineup, aiming to further challenge Nvidia by building on its rapid rise in the AI chip market, a market already worth hundreds of billions of dollars. Google will launch two new tensor processing units (TPUs). TPUs are Google-designed specialty chips mainly used to develop and run AI software. The new versions target confidential computing and helping AI models access broader information when handling requests. Overall, the chips aim to meet growing demand as the industry shifts toward AI agents while addressing the accompanying security challenges. The release also signals that Google's chip unit is speeding up iteration: previously Google typically launched a new AI processor every two years, while this year the unit introduced two chips at once, and the newest version to be released Monday will further expand that lineup. Amin Vahdat, who heads Google's chip business, said in an interview that the four TPU products will each be optimized for different needs, saying: "This really follows a philosophy Google has always held: the future belongs to specialization, and the advantages of specialization remain very significant." Google chose to expand amid turbulence in the AI chip industry: concerns that AI infrastructure investment may slow have rattled tech stocks, and Democratic gains in the U.S. midterm elections add new uncertainty for data center projects. Still, demand for Nvidia's AI processors continues to exceed supply, leaving room for Google and other competitors to build sizable businesses. Vahdat said the new TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max are not wholly redesigned chips but reconfigurations of existing chips to meet specific customer needs. TPU 8tx mainly targets customers handling secure, confidential data, such as government agencies and companies in heavily regulated industries, and will work alongside AMD chips as part of Google's partnership with AMD. TPU 8i Max targets scenarios requiring very long context windows; the context window determines how much data an AI system can consider in a single request. Vahdat said such capability matters for tasks such as drug discovery and mathematical computation, and is also important for coding applications. The TPU market is currently dominated by Nvidia's graphics processing units (GPUs). Google began developing the technology more than a decade ago and partnered with Broadcom, which helped with chip design and coordinated production. Google originally built TPUs to meet the search giant's growing compute needs more efficiently, then found TPUs also had great potential in AI computing, and now sells them to customers beyond its own cloud business. Bloomberg Intelligence expects Google's TPU sales to exceed $135 billion by 2028, including related software and hardware revenue — far above this year's projected $12 billion — and that figure excludes revenue generated by customers using TPUs through Google Cloud. Google's TPUs have already attracted well-known customers including Apple, Meta and Oracle. Vahdat said offering specialized chip versions for different uses will help Google expand its market further, and the new versions are expected to go on sale next year. "We could build one general-purpose chip that tries to serve the whole market, or we could offer different specialized versions. Through the latter, we can actually create more value for customers," he said. Even Nvidia, which has long positioned GPUs as general-purpose products for all AI tasks, is now offering more specialized chip systems, including its own central processing units (CPUs) — a category pioneered by companies such as Intel — which do not handle the massive data operations needed to train AI models but are well suited to managing AI agents. Nvidia is also strengthening its chips for the AI inference stage, using technology from its acquisition of startup Groq to launch products more focused on that stage. Google's TPU 8tx will be paired with AMD CPUs. Vahdat said the technology can encrypt data at the chip level to improve security; conventional computers typically must first decrypt information in memory when processing data, whereas TPU 8tx avoids this problem. items.why_zh: 推测：谷歌以面向机密计算与超长上下文的专业化 TPU 版本细分市场，可能在英伟达主导的 AI 芯片格局中争取更多企业客户（此为推测；文中 1350 亿美元的销售预测来自彭博行业研究）。
items.why_en: Speculation: by segmenting the market with specialized TPUs for confidential computing and very long context, Google may win more enterprise customers in an AI chip landscape dominated by Nvidia (an inference; the $135 billion sales forecast in the article comes from Bloomberg Intelligence).

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，据红魔游戏手机官微，红魔游戏平板 5 Pro 16GB+1TB“满配大存储”版本将于今晚 8 时正式开售。该产品搭载 RGB 水冷散热、185Hz OLED 屏、第五代骁龙 8 至尊版处理器，到手价 6999 元。 京东 努比亚红魔游戏平板 5Pro 16GB+1TB 6999 元 直达链接 红魔游戏平板 5 PRO 已于 6 月 30 日正式发布 ，采用透明水冷设计，号称“口袋里的游戏神器”，首销 4999 元起、国补价 4499 元起。 据IT之家了解，红魔游戏平板 5 PRO 搭载 第五代骁龙 8 至尊版处理器 + 红芯 R4，匹配 ICE 魔冷散热架构，支持水冷 RGB 散热技术。平板内置 8300mAh 电池，搭载双 USB-C 接口，支持 80W 有线充电，支持旁路充电 PRO。 该平板还搭载全新 PC 模拟器 Steam 直连模式，低门槛畅玩 PC 大作。同时内置了 AI 战术教练和 AI 魔姬嘴替两大功能，前者支持赛前赛中提供选英雄、出装战术等游戏指导，后者支持 DeepSeek 自然回复交流。 京东 11.11 无门槛红包 面额至高 26888 元，每天抽 3 次： 点此抽红包 。 淘宝 11.11 无门槛红包 面额至高 26888 元，每天抽 1 次： 点此抽红包 。
items.summary_en: ITHome, Nov 9: According to RedMagic's official gaming-phone Weibo account, the RedMagic Gaming Tablet 5 Pro 16GB+1TB 'maxed-out storage' version will officially go on sale at 8 p.m. tonight. The product features RGB liquid-cooling, a 185Hz OLED screen and a fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 Elite processor, at a final price of 6,999 yuan. The RedMagic Gaming Tablet 5 Pro was officially launched on June 30 with a transparent liquid-cooling design, billed as a 'gaming powerhouse in your pocket,' starting at 4,999 yuan at first sale and 4,499 yuan with national subsidy. According to ITHome, the RedMagic Gaming Tablet 5 Pro packs a fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 Elite processor plus the Red Core R4, paired with the ICE cooling architecture and liquid-cooling RGB technology. The tablet has an 8,300mAh battery, dual USB-C ports, 80W wired charging and Bypass Charging Pro. It also features a new PC emulator with a Steam direct-connect mode for playing PC titles with a low barrier to entry. It also includes two features, an AI tactical coach and an AI 'Moji' chat stand-in: the former provides in-game guidance such as hero selection and item builds before and during matches, while the latter supports natural-reply conversations via DeepSeek.

items.why_en: Speculation: marketing features such as an AI tactical coach and an AI chat stand-in suggests device-side AI is being used by consumer hardware makers as a point of differentiation (an inference).

items.title_en: WEY's second-generation Lanshan opens pre-sales: a smart luxury boxy SUV priced at RMB 289,800–329,800
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，魏牌二代蓝山今天（9 日）晚间正式开启预售，新车定位智慧豪华方盒子 SUV，提供 5 座、6 座合计 4 款配置，价格区间为 28.98 万-32.98 万元。 五座：登峰版 28.98 万元，巅峰版 30.98 万元 六座：登峰版 30.98 万元，巅峰版 32.98 万元 据IT之家了解，二代蓝山基于长城归元 S 平台打造。新车尺寸根据座位布局有所区分。五座版长宽高为 5140×2050×1960mm，六座版车长增至 5300mm，宽度和高度保持不变，两个版本的轴距均为 3010mm。六座版多出的 160mm 车长主要用于第三排乘坐空间和后备厢容积。 新车搭载高通新一代舱驾一体 8797 旗舰芯片与 NVIDIA DRIVE Thor-U 驾驶辅助芯片，支撑复杂地形下的毫秒级决策。同时，还拥有双 VLA Plus 大模型，搭载长城 Coffee AI OS 4 智能座舱系统以及 Coffee Pilot 4 全地形辅助驾驶系统。 动力方面，新车放弃了初代的 1.5T 混动，换装 2.0T 发动机， 最大功率 182kW，匹配前 110kW、后 220kW 双电机和 4 挡混动专用变速箱 。 电池容量方面，工信部申报信息显示提供 53.6kWh 和 64.7kWh 两个版本，WLTC 工况 纯电续航分别为 220km 和 270km ；53.6kWh 版本最高车速为 205km/h，64.7kWh 版本为 210km/h。 该车底盘配备双腔空气悬架和后桥机械差速锁，空气悬架支持车身高度与悬架软硬调节。值得一提的是，该车还支持后轮转向。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 9: WEY's second-generation Lanshan officially opened pre-sales on the evening of Nov 9. Positioned as a smart luxury boxy SUV, it offers four configurations across 5-seat and 6-seat layouts, priced RMB 289,800–329,800. Five-seat: Dengfeng 289,800 yuan, Dianfeng 309,800 yuan; six-seat: Dengfeng 309,800 yuan, Dianfeng 329,800 yuan. Built on Great Wall's Guiyuan S platform, it varies in size by layout: the five-seat version measures 5140×2050×1960mm, while the six-seat version grows to 5300mm in length with width and height unchanged; both have a 3010mm wheelbase, and the six-seat version's extra 160mm goes mainly to third-row space and cargo capacity. It uses Qualcomm's new-generation cockpit-driving integrated 8797 flagship chip and NVIDIA DRIVE Thor-U driver-assistance chip, supporting millisecond-level decisions on complex terrain. It also features dual VLA Plus large models, Great Wall's Coffee AI OS 4 smart cockpit system and Coffee Pilot 4 all-terrain driver-assistance system. For power, it drops the first generation's 1.5T hybrid for a 2.0T engine with 182kW maximum output, paired with 110kW front and 220kW rear dual motors and a 4-speed hybrid dedicated transmission. MIIT filing information shows 53.6kWh and 64.7kWh battery options with WLTC all-electric ranges of 220km and 270km respectively; top speed is 205km/h for the 53.6kWh version and 210km/h for the 64.7kWh version. The chassis has dual-chamber air suspension with height and damping adjustment, a rear mechanical differential lock, and rear-wheel steering.
items.why_zh: 推测：换代车型以 2.0T 插混、双 AI 芯片与后轮转向等配置进入 30 万元级区间，可能加剧该细分市场竞争，但实际表现有待验证。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，魏牌二代蓝山今天（9 日）晚间正式开启预售，新车定位智慧豪华方盒子 SUV，提供 5 座、6 座合计 4 款配置，价格区间为 28.98 万-32.98 万元。 五座：登峰版 28.98 万元，巅峰版 30.98 万元 六座：登峰版 30.98 万元，巅峰版 32.98 万元 据IT之家了解，二代蓝山基于长城归元 S 平台打造。新车尺寸根据座位布局有所区分。五座版长宽高为 5140×2050×1960mm，六座版车长增至 5300mm，宽度和高度保持不变，两个版本的轴距均为 3010mm。六座版多出的 160mm 车长主要用于第三排乘坐空间和后备厢容积。 新车搭载高通新一代舱驾一体 8797 旗舰芯片与 NVIDIA DRIVE Thor-U 驾驶辅助芯片，支撑复杂地形下的毫秒级决策。同时，还拥有双 VLA Plus 大模型，搭载长城 Coffee AI OS 4 智能座舱系统以及 Coffee Pilot 4 全地形辅助驾驶系统。 动力方面，新车放弃了初代的 1.5T 混动，换装 2.0T 发动机， 最大功率 182kW，匹配前 110kW、后 220kW 双电机和 4 挡混动专用变速箱 。 电池容量方面，工信部申报信息显示提供 53.6kWh 和 64.7kWh 两个版本，WLTC 工况 纯电续航分别为 220km 和 270km ；53.6kWh 版本最高车速为 205km/h，64.7kWh 版本为 210km/h。 该车底盘配备双腔空气悬架和后桥机械差速锁，空气悬架支持车身高度与悬架软硬调节。值得一提的是，该车还支持后轮转向。

items.title_zh: 特斯拉 Robotaxi 无人驾驶出租车服务落地至圣安东尼奥，成迄今规模最大运营城市
items.title_en: Tesla Robotaxi launches in San Antonio, its largest service area to date
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，特斯拉 Robotaxi 无人驾驶出租车服务现已扩展至美国得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥市。特斯拉官方 Robotaxi 账号于当地时间周一午夜刚过在 X 平台宣布了这一消息，无人监督的自动驾驶出行服务于当天上午 5 点（美国中部时间）正式上线。 IT之家注意到，这是特斯拉连续两周开通新的 Robotaxi 运营城市。此前，该公司已于 11 月 2 日在得克萨斯州沃思堡（Fort Worth）推出无人监督的 Robotaxi 服务。 迄今规模最大的 Robotaxi 服务区域 圣安东尼奥此次开放的服务区域约为 275 平方英里（约 712 平方公里），是特斯拉 Robotaxi 服务启动时覆盖范围最大的城市。相比之下，奥斯汀的服务区域约为 272 平方英里（约 704 平方公里）。自 2025 年 6 月在奥斯汀启动服务以来，特斯拉一直在扩大当地的运营范围。 按照特斯拉公布的服务区域面积，目前各个提供无人监督 Robotaxi 服务的城市规模如下： 城市 服务区域面积 圣安东尼奥 约 275 平方英里 奥斯汀 272 平方英里 休斯敦 254 平方英里 沃思堡 143 平方英里 达拉斯 81 平方英里 迈阿密 31 平方英里 奥兰多 26 平方英里 坦帕 24 平方英里 圣安东尼奥的服务区域覆盖整个市中心，以及 410 号环城公路（Loop 410）以内几乎所有区域，并在大部分方向上延伸至环城公路以外。 具体来看，北部服务范围沿 10 号州际公路（I-10）至 281 号美国国道（US-281）之间的 1604 号环城公路（Loop 1604）延伸，并沿 I-10 向北略微超出 Loop 1604；西部延伸至 151 号州道以外，东部越过 35 号州际公路（I-35），南部则越过 I-410，延伸至 37 号州际公路（I-37）附近。 随着圣安东尼奥加入，特斯拉目前已在 8 座城市提供无人监督的 Robotaxi 服务，所有服务区域合计覆盖约 420 万人口。完整的运营区域统计还包括旧金山湾区的有人监督服务区域。 不过，官方公布的服务区域面积并不能反映全部实际情况。近期一项分析发现，特斯拉在得克萨斯州的 Robotaxi 实际接送区域比官方公布的范围小 22% 至 41%，尽管仍然覆盖了当地大部分居民。 新城市扩张符合此前计划 沃思堡的开通曾让外界感到意外，因为特斯拉此前公布的 Robotaxi 下一批运营城市名单中并没有它。不过，圣安东尼奥早已出现在计划之中。 在上个月举行的第三季度财报电话会议上，特斯拉曾将拉斯维加斯、菲尼克斯、杰克逊维尔和圣安东尼奥列为下一批 Robotaxi 运营城市。沃思堡上线后，外界一度猜测特斯拉是否还会迅速推出更多新市场，而圣安东尼奥仅在一周后便正式加入。 与此同时，特斯拉也在持续改善现有城市的服务。该公司近期延长了奥斯汀 Robotaxi 的运营时间，并新增 Calm Mode（平静模式），可以隐藏触摸屏上容易分散乘客注意力的视觉效果，让乘车体验更加轻松。 Cybercab 无人驾驶出租车也将继续扩张 圣安东尼奥目前使用 Model Y 车型提供 Robotaxi 服务，但特斯拉的专用无人驾驶出租车 Cybercab 也在同步扩大运营规模。 目前，特斯拉在奥斯汀投入运营的 Cybercab 已超过 300 辆。本月，该公司还计划在达拉斯推出 Cybercab 出行服务，这将是该车型首次在奥斯汀以外的城市投入运营。 两周内连续开通两座新城市，而拉斯维加斯、菲尼克斯和杰克逊维尔仍在扩张名单之中。因此，如果特斯拉下周再次宣布开通新的 Robotaxi 运营城市，也不会令人意外。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 9: Tesla's Robotaxi service has expanded to San Antonio, Texas. Tesla's official Robotaxi account announced it on X just after midnight local time Monday, with the driverless service going live at 5 a.m. Central Time that day. It is the second consecutive week Tesla has opened a new city, after launching unsupervised Robotaxi service in Fort Worth, Texas, on Nov 2. San Antonio's initial service area of about 275 square miles (~712 km²) is the largest of any city at Tesla Robotaxi launch; Austin's is about 272 square miles (~704 km²), and Tesla has kept expanding there since launching in June 2025. Based on officially published areas, the cities are: San Antonio ~275 sq mi, Austin 272, Houston 254, Fort Worth 143, Dallas 81, Miami 31, Orlando 26 and Tampa 24. San Antonio's area covers the entire downtown and nearly everything inside Loop 410, extending beyond the loop in most directions: north along I-10 to Loop 1604 between I-10 and US-281 and slightly past Loop 1604; west beyond State Highway 151; east past I-35; and south past I-410 to near I-37. With San Antonio, Tesla now offers unsupervised Robotaxi service in eight cities, with all service areas covering about 4.2 million people; the full tally also includes supervised service areas in the San Francisco Bay Area. The published areas do not tell the whole story, however: a recent analysis found Tesla's actual pickup and drop-off zones in Texas are 22% to 41% smaller than the published areas, though they still cover most local residents. Fort Worth's launch surprised observers because it was not on the previously announced list, while San Antonio had long been planned — on last quarter's earnings call Tesla named Las Vegas, Phoenix, Jacksonville and San Antonio as the next Robotaxi cities. Tesla has also recently extended Austin Robotaxi hours and added a Calm Mode that hides potentially distracting visuals on the touchscreen. San Antonio currently uses Model Y vehicles; more than 300 purpose-built Cybercabs are operating in Austin, and Tesla plans to launch Cybercab service in Dallas this month, the model's first deployment outside Austin.
items.why_zh: 推测：单城服务面积创新高，说明特斯拉无人监督运营的地理扩张在加速；但报道同时指出官方面积与实际接送范围存在差距，扩张质量仍需独立核实。
items.why_en: Speculative: a record service area for a single city suggests Tesla is accelerating the geographic rollout of unsupervised operations, but the report also notes a gap between published and actual service zones, so the quality of that expansion still needs independent verification.

items.title_zh: 大疆 Osmo Pocket 4P 云台相机固件更新：解锁 18 倍变焦、iPhone 即拍即传等功能
items.title_en: DJI Osmo Pocket 4P gimbal camera firmware update adds 18x zoom and instant iPhone transfer
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，大疆今天（9 日）晚间宣布，云台相机 Osmo Pocket 4P 获得固件更新，版本号为 V01.02.11.49，四大功能一次解锁： 18 倍变焦、新增场景预设、iPhone 即拍即传、Livephoto 玩法升级 。 IT之家从官方获悉，此次新增的 18 倍变焦功能，拍照、录像都能用，不过不支持慢动作、延时摄影模式下使用。当远距离抓拍舞台或自然风光时，可使用 12×-18× 变焦锁定主体细节，搭配“智能跟随 8.0”可实现稳定远摄跟拍。 场景预设方面，此次新增 舞台、日落时刻 两个场景预设，同样适用于视频和照片拍摄。前者实现曝光、对焦、收音再升级，舞台上的暗光和复杂灯光能够从容应对；后者则针对日落场景进行精细化调整，为高光和暖色保留动态范围。 此次更新带来的 iPhone 即拍即传功能，支持照片与 Livephoto 照片。开启该功能后， 拍摄素材会在系统后台资源空闲时，自动向手机发起传输 。据了解，该功能当前支持 iOS 26.4.1 及以上版本，推荐搭配 iPhone 16 及以上机型以获得最佳体验。 此外，Osmo Pocket 4P 机内 LivePhoto 功能升级，可通过 AI 算法 识别拍摄视频中的高光时刻 ，自动生成 Live Photo 照片。回放素材时，也可手动标记高光瞬间并生成 LivePhoto 照片。与支持无感传片的手机连接后，在关屏状态下，LivePhoto 照片可自动同步至手机相册，便于直接分享。 其他升级功能项目如下： 优化 4K/30fps 下的中焦镜头画质。 优化智能跟随使用体验和跟随稳定性。 优化多摄切换体验，变焦时的画面过渡更自然。 新增华为设备直连分享功能，可在相机回放界面选择素材，一键分享至华为设备。 相机关机状态下，支持使用 USB 线以 U 盘模式连接电脑或支持 OTG 的手机，管理相机中的素材。 相机关机休眠后，支持通过最新版本的 DJI Mimoapp 预览和下载素材。 优化无线直播、DP 输出及网络摄像头模式下中焦镜头画质，提升画面解析力和变焦流畅度。 优化非人像高动态场景下的画质。 优化亲子场景下视频拍摄的色彩和亮度表现。 优化 HDR 视频在机身屏幕上的显示和回放效果。 优化使用中焦镜头时的云台稳定性。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 9: DJI announced on the evening of Nov 9 that the Osmo Pocket 4P gimbal camera has received firmware version V01.02.11.49, unlocking four features at once: 18x zoom, new scene presets, instant iPhone transfer and upgraded LivePhoto capabilities. The new 18x zoom works for both photos and video but is not available in slow-motion or timelapse modes; for distant stage shots or landscapes, 12x–18x zoom can lock in subject detail, and with Smart Follow 8.0 it enables stable long-range tracking. Two scene presets are added — Stage and Sunset — for both video and photos: the former upgrades exposure, focus and audio to handle dim stage lighting and complex light, while the latter fine-tunes for sunsets, preserving dynamic range in highlights and warm tones. Instant iPhone transfer supports photos and LivePhoto images; once enabled, footage is automatically sent to the phone when system background resources are idle. The feature currently requires iOS 26.4.1 or later, with iPhone 16 and newer recommended for the best experience. The in-camera LivePhoto feature is upgraded: AI algorithms identify highlight moments in recorded video and automatically generate Live Photo images, and highlights can also be marked manually during playback. When connected to a phone that supports seamless transfer, LivePhoto images sync automatically to the phone album even with the screen off, making sharing easier. Other updates include: improved mid-tele lens image quality at 4K/30fps; improved Smart Follow experience and stability; improved multi-camera switching with more natural transitions while zooming; a new direct share feature for Huawei devices, letting users select clips in playback and share them to Huawei devices with one tap; support for connecting the powered-off camera to a computer or OTG-capable phone via USB in U-disk mode to manage footage; support for previewing and downloading footage via the latest DJI Mimo app after the camera has been powered off and gone to sleep; improved mid-tele lens image quality in wireless livestream, DP output and webcam modes with better detail and smoother zooming; improved image quality in non-portrait high-dynamic scenes; improved color and brightness in videos of parent-child scenes; improved HDR video display and playback on the camera screen; and improved gimbal stability when using the mid-tele lens.
items.why_zh: 推测：18 倍变焦与 AI 自动生成 LivePhoto 等更新，意味着 Pocket 系列在硬件不变的情况下靠软件持续扩展拍摄场景。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，大疆今天（9 日）晚间宣布，云台相机 Osmo Pocket 4P 获得固件更新，版本号为 V01.02.11.49，四大功能一次解锁： 18 倍变焦、新增场景预设、iPhone 即拍即传、Livephoto 玩法升级 。 IT之家从官方获悉，此次新增的 18 倍变焦功能，拍照、录像都能用，不过不支持慢动作、延时摄影模式下使用。当远距离抓拍舞台或自然风光时，可使用 12×-18× 变焦锁定主体细节，搭配“智能跟随 8.0”可实现稳定远摄跟拍。 场景预设方面，此次新增 舞台、日落时刻 两个场景预设，同样适用于视频和照片拍摄。前者实现曝光、对焦、收音再升级，舞台上的暗光和复杂灯光能够从容应对；后者则针对日落场景进行精细化调整，为高光和暖色保留动态范围。 此次更新带来的 iPhone 即拍即传功能，支持照片与 Livephoto 照片。开启该功能后， 拍摄素材会在系统后台资源空闲时，自动向手机发起传输 。据了解，该功能当前支持 iOS 26.4.1 及以上版本，推荐搭配 iPhone 16 及以上机型以获得最佳体验。 此外，Osmo Pocket 4P 机内 LivePhoto 功能升级，可通过 AI 算法 识别拍摄视频中的高光时刻 ，自动生成 Live Photo 照片。回放素材时，也可手动标记高光瞬间并生成 LivePhoto 照片。与支持无感传片的手机连接后，在关屏状态下，LivePhoto 照片可自动同步至手机相册，便于直接分享。 其他升级功能项目如下： 优化 4K/30fps 下的中焦镜头画质。 优化智能跟随使用体验和跟随稳定性。 优化多摄切换体验，变焦时的画面过渡更自然。 新增华为设备直连分享功能，可在相机回放界面选择素材，一键分享至华为设备。 相机关机状态下，支持使用 USB 线以 U 盘模式连接电脑或支持 OTG 的手机，管理相机中的素材。 相机关机休眠后，支持通过最新版本的 DJI Mimoapp 预览和下载素材。 优化无线直播、DP 输出及网络摄像头模式下中焦镜头画质，提升画面解析力和变焦流畅度。 优化非人像高动态场景下的画质。 优化亲子场景下视频拍摄的色彩和亮度表现。 优化 HDR 视频在机身屏幕上的显示和回放效果。 优化使用中焦镜头时的云台稳定性。

items.summary_en: The Huawei FreeClip 2 earbuds carry an official price of RMB 1,299. Today, JD self-operated PLUS members can get them for RMB 879 via a 150-yuan instant discount available in multiple cities plus a 15% national subsidy, or RMB 931 with a 10% national subsidy instead. The article also includes links to JD and Taobao 11.11 red-envelope draws. As for the product, the FreeClip 2 uses Huawei's third-generation self-developed low-power chip with an NPU AI processor delivering 10x the computing power; it supports the HarmonyOS AI earbud assistant, including head-motion broadcast, smart broadcast, Xiaoyi wake-up and Xiaoyi translation. It uses φ10.8mm open-fit dual-diaphragm acoustic units with 100% higher loudness and 100% more low-frequency power; a 60mAh battery gives 9 hours per charge and 38 hours with the charging case (537mAh battery), with 10 minutes of charging yielding 3 hours of playback. It supports L2HC audio coding, adaptive smart volume, smart vocal enhancement, spatial audio (40% lower head-tracking latency) and NearLink precise finding (IT Home notes the NearLink audio experience is to be upgraded by the end of 2025). It also upgrades to skin-friendly liquid silicone with high-performance memory metal, 25% softer, weighs 5.1g per earbud and is IP57 dust- and water-resistant.

items.summary_en: The Shokz OpenDots 2 earbuds went on sale in May 2026 at a launch price of RMB 1,298. Today the JD flagship store cut the price directly to RMB 859, and JD PLUS members can spend 2 points to grab an 800-80 yuan coupon, bringing it to 779 yuan; orders placed between 20:00 and 24:00 on Nov 9 earn a 50-yuan E-card, and posting a review earns another 30-yuan E-card plus a Xiaomi 20,000mAh power bank, a Shokz thermos and a UGREEN wireless charger, equivalent to 699 yuan after the cards. The article also includes coupon and red-envelope links. As for the product, the OpenDots 2 upgrades to flexible titanium sheets with an optimized width-to-thickness ratio; the dynamic titanium arc carries 9g of preload and uses an asymmetric curved design. It houses 11.8mm symmetric dual drivers with distortion improved 70% over the previous generation, and adds newly upgraded Dolby audio. It comes in three colors — Platinum White, Black Star and Silver Cedar — with no left/right distinction, features built-in AI call noise reduction, supports wireless charging, and offers 10 hours of playback (40 hours with the case). It is IP57 dust- and water-resistant, upgrades to Bluetooth 6.1 and supports dual-device connection.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，漫步者 W900NB 30 周年典藏版头戴蓝牙耳机今晚 20:00 开售，售价 1159 元。这款耳机提供晨雾白、暗夜黑、深海蓝三种颜色可选，限量 3000 套，每台配备独立蚀刻编号。 这款耳机配备 8 颗高精度广角硅麦，采用 6 颗 FF 前馈麦环形布局 + 2 颗 FB 反馈麦的组合，降噪深度达 -50dB；采用 6nm 制程 6 核异构芯片，集成 Arm Ethos U55 独立 NPU，实现端到端 AI 拾音降噪；搭载六轴传感头部追踪技术，支持杜比全景声。 这款耳机采用 10mm PET 镀钛高音单元 + 40mm 双层 PEEK 复合航空纤维中低音单元的双单元组合，通过 Hi-Res、Hi-Res Wireless、HWA 三金标认证，搭载 LHDC5.0 高清音频编解码，支持 192kHz/24bit 采样率。 续航表现方面，该耳机在 SBC 编码、降噪开启状态下续航可达 42 小时，降噪关闭状态下总续航可达 110 小时；采用 LHDC 高清编码时，降噪开启续航为 33 小时，降噪关闭为 73 小时；同时支持快充，充电 15 分钟可听 17 小时。 IT之家附这款新品主要参数： 京东 漫步者 W900NB 30 周年典藏版 1159 元 直达链接 京东 11.11 无门槛红包 面额至高 26888 元，每天抽 3 次： 点此抽红包 。 淘宝 11.11 无门槛红包 面额至高 26888 元，每天抽 1 次： 点此抽红包 。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 9: the Edifier W900NB 30th Anniversary Edition over-ear Bluetooth headset goes on sale tonight at 20:00 for RMB 1,159. It comes in Morning Mist White, Night Black and Deep Sea Blue, limited to 3,000 units, each with an individually etched number. The headset has eight high-precision wide-angle silicon microphones — six feed-forward mics in a ring layout plus two feedback mics — for noise cancellation depth of up to -50dB. It uses a 6nm six-core heterogeneous chip with an integrated Arm Ethos U55 dedicated NPU for end-to-end AI pickup and noise reduction, and features six-axis sensor head tracking with Dolby Atmos support. Audio is handled by a dual-driver setup: a 10mm PET titanium-coated tweeter plus a 40mm dual-layer PEEK composite aviation-fiber woofer. It holds Hi-Res, Hi-Res Wireless and HWA certifications, uses LHDC 5.0 high-definition audio codec and supports 192kHz/24bit sampling. For battery life, with SBC coding it lasts up to 42 hours with noise cancellation on and up to 110 hours total with it off; with LHDC it lasts 33 hours with ANC on and 73 hours with it off. Fast charging gives 17 hours of listening from a 15-minute charge.
